basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old IT enthusiast based in Manchester, UK, who recently started diving into Linux and open-source projects. I work as a junior network administrator, and my hours can be erratic, but I usually have free time in the evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my downtime exploring new tech gadgets, playing snooker, and tinkering with DIY electronics. I dislike overly complicated tech jargon and prefer simple, straightforward solutions. My friends often joke that I'm the go-to 'tech support' guy.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: While I have a formal education in computer science, most of my knowledge about Linux and server management has been self-taught through online tutorials, forums, and trial-and-error. I have a foundational understanding of network setups, but I'm still learning the ropes with more advanced configurations like Docker and port forwarding.
